text: In which month and year did Beethoven move permanently from Bonn to Vienna?

meta.exposure_note: exposed in git history through f819d9b; reclassified shadow-dev per Issue 1; never sealed

sufficient_sets.text: In November 1792, Beethoven moved permanently to Vienna from Bonn amid rumours of war spilling out of France. Shortly after his departure, Beethoven learned that his father had died. Over the next few years, he responded to the widespread feeling that he was a successor to the recently deceased Mozart by studying Mozart's work and writing works with a distinctly Mozartian flavour; see Beethoven and Mozart.
